# Regnskabsbrag og rentegyser i USA: Hvad gør eksperterne nu?

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-08-28  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish EuroInvestor Millionærklubben episode with Lars Persson and Lars Svendsen. It covers a positive Nordic market morning, earnings from Salesforce and Scandinavian Tobacco, and scepticism about whether Fed chief Warsh's Jackson Hole speech will move markets while US long-term rates are high. Much of the discussion is about tanker and LPG shipping earnings, which the panel sees as a bonanza, especially Frontline and BW LPG. In the listener Q&A the panel holds Scandinavian Tobacco and Genmab, splits on Ambu, and avoids Rolls-Royce, ALK (too expensive) and RWE, with Svendsen preferring Verbund.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 AMBU-B — Ambu | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Svendsen is adding and sees 200 in three years; Persson sold short term but believes in it long term.

#### Reasoning

Svendsen (guest) bought at 103 and 53 and plans to add more. Newer products such as endoscopy for the gut and urinary tract grow about 15%, and only the legacy products are weak. Persson sold after the drop, against his own rules, but would rebuy on a bottom formation. Overall the view is positive long term but split short term.

#### Sell Triggers

- new product growth slows
- further guidance cuts

> *"jeg skal fylde på ... i mit perspektiv, så koster den 200 om, jeg tror faktisk, jeg vil gøre om tre år"*

---

### 🟢 LUG — Lundin Gold | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Persson plans to buy with the proceeds from the Ambu sale as gold rallies.

#### Reasoning

Persson (host panel) says he is 'in love' with Lundin Gold and expects to buy today or tomorrow, riding the gold price momentum.

#### Sell Triggers

- gold price reverses

> *"så var det jo den der lundin guld, som jeg er lidt forelsket i"*

---

### 🟡 FRO — Frontline | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Strong Q3 bookings and a big dividend, but Svendsen took profit on about 45% at around fair value.

#### Reasoning

Rates are high and Q3 is 80% booked. Restocking is expected to keep strength for 2-3 quarters. Svendsen sees about USD 45 as fair and sold about 45% of the position, keeping the rest. The Middle East and Russia could extend the upside.

#### Sell Triggers

- Middle East normalises and rates fall
- price well above USD 45

> *"jeg har solgt 45 procent af vores Frontline"*

---

### 🟡 BWLPG — BW LPG | **HOLD** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Svendsen has a full position and a target of 250, with futures rates far above last year's.

#### Reasoning

Rates for the rest of the year are around USD 180k/day versus 45k in 2025. The company will be debt-free and pays a large dividend. The LPG segment is less volatile than large tankers. The earnings miss came from trading losses.

#### Sell Triggers

- LPG rates collapse
- trading losses persist

> *"nu har jeg alt, hvad jeg skal bruge af den, og jeg tror, den skal op i 250"*

---

### 🔴 NAT — Nordic American Tankers | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Svendsen sold it as one of his weaker tanker holdings.

#### Reasoning

He is cutting weaker tanker names while keeping his stronger ones.

> *"så har vi Nat, Nordic American"*

---

### 🔴 TNK — Teekay Tankers | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Svendsen sold it.

#### Reasoning

He is trimming the weaker tanker names.

> *"Og det har så været TK Tankers"*

---

### 🔴 INSW — International Seaways | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Svendsen sold it.

#### Reasoning

He is trimming the weaker tanker names.

> *"det har været den der International Seaways"*

---

### 🟡 DHT — DHT Holdings | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Svendsen keeps it among his core tankers.

#### Reasoning

It is one of the tanker names he kept after trimming.

#### Sell Triggers

- tanker rates normalise

> *"vi har DHT, den dobbeltholdt Tankers"*

---

### 🟡 TEN — Tsakos Energy Navigation | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Svendsen keeps it.

#### Reasoning

It is one of the tanker names he kept after trimming.

#### Sell Triggers

- tanker rates normalise

> *"vi har TEN til Sakros"*

---

### 🟡 STG — Scandinavian Tobacco Group | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Both hosts hold it as a dividend stock after a recovery from the bottom, targeting 90-100.

#### Reasoning

Margins are holding despite falling sales. Logistics problems are now fixed and the stock is in a rising trend. The product sale to Japan Tobacco for about 1bn is positive. Both Persson and Svendsen keep their shares.

#### Sell Triggers

- margins deteriorate
- trend breaks

> *"Så nej, jeg holder fast i den"*

---

### 🟡 GMAB — Genmab | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Persson keeps his core position while the stock tests 2200 resistance; Svendsen would only buy near 1600.

#### Reasoning

The data flow has been a tailwind, and a breakout above 2200 on the third attempt is possible. Svendsen treats it as bottom fishing and would only buy cheap, around 1600, after the Dutch acquisition.

#### Sell Triggers

- fails at 2200 resistance
- weak trial data

> *"Men jeg beholder mine"*

---

### ⛔ RR — Rolls-Royce | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Up 655% in 3.5 years and stretched; both hosts pass on it despite good technical signals.

#### Reasoning

Svendsen is not attracted to it, pointing to the COVID rescue share issue. Persson says the technicals are fine but the valuation (GBP 128bn) is stretched and he prefers Nordic electrification names.

> *"Så jeg tror, at jeg melder pas"*

---

### ⛔ ALK-B — ALK-Abelló | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

P/E 32 and very expensive, with sell signals since July; Svendsen keeps only a core position.

#### Reasoning

The long-term allergy tablet thesis is intact but the stock is priced very high. Persson says models flagged sell in July, momentum is lost and support is at 200. Their advice is to take profits and wait to buy cheaper.

> *"den er meget, meget højt prissat"*

---

### ⛔ RWE — RWE | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Svendsen sees no reason to own it, citing capex and regulatory risk; the chart is steady but lacks momentum.

#### Reasoning

Thermal power carries a high variable cost, and regulatory squeezes have hurt peers such as Uniper. Heavy grid investments will pressure margins. Svendsen prefers Verbund.

> *"det er ikke noget, jeg vil putte penge i"*

---

### 🟠 VER — Verbund | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Svendsen prefers its hydropower over RWE but has not bought yet.

#### Reasoning

Hydropower is the best asset class in his view, but low river levels argue for waiting.

#### Sell Triggers

- prolonged low water levels

> *"Den, jeg vil putte penge i, hvis jeg skulle ... det hedder Færbundt"*

---

### 🟠 FLS — FLSmidth | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Good week; needs to break the resistance at 600.

#### Reasoning

Persson's technical read is that mining order momentum is good and a break above 600 is the trigger to watch.

#### Sell Triggers

- rejected at 600

> *"Den har så modstandsniveauet 600, den skal komme igennem"*

---

### 🟠 NSIS-B — Novonesis | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

A quality stock that is permanently expensive; buy on a down day.

#### Reasoning

Svendsen advises waiting for a weak day rather than chasing the price.

> *"så vent til, han kommer ned på en god dag, og så køber du den"*

---
